recommendation: Do not reopen SOL failed-range reclaim as a new V57 experiment. The proposed mechanism is a parameter variant of an already tested and rejected causal family, and no new regime or source evidence justifies another selection pass.
why_now: Trade-Oracle independently suggested a long SOL failed-range reclaim while V57 collects sparse exact-route evidence. The suggestion was screened against the local hypothesis ledger before any implementation or replay.
evidence_reviewed: The existing five-minute range_reclaim_v1 signal implementation: prior 240-bar boundary, wick beyond the range, completed close back inside, midpoint constraint, next-bar execution, both sides, and two declared exits.
The immutable development replay from 2025-07-28 through 2026-01-28.
The immutable validation replay from 2026-01-28 through 2026-04-28.
The immutable pseudo-holdout replay from 2026-04-28 through 2026-07-28.
The Trade-Oracle response was treated only as a hypothesis generator because it returned no supporting source citations and used generic friction assumptions.
observed_problem_or_opportunity: The proposed 120-bar long reclaim is not a materially different mechanism from range_reclaim_v1; it changes a lookback parameter after a broad family failure. SOL long reclaim lost under both exits in all three chronological partitions. The strongest pseudo-holdout cell was short wick/ATR, only +$124.30 with PF 1.0724, while its development and validation predecessors lost $1,375.01/PF 0.7665 and $1,399.06/PF 0.5771 respectively.
applicable_market_regime: Five-minute SOL failed-range breaks across three chronological partitions spanning 2025-07-28 through 2026-07-28; the screen does not claim every future SOL regime is equivalent.
alternatives_considered: Run the Oracle's 120-bar long-only parameter immediately; rejected because it is post-rejection parameter selection without new mechanism evidence.
Promote the pseudo-holdout short wick/ATR cell; rejected because development and validation were both materially negative and selecting the sole later positive cell is post-hoc.
Retune sweep distance, range width, or midpoint rule; deferred unless a preregistered changed-regime diagnosis or distinct causal mechanism is supplied.
Continue collecting exact active V57 HYPE, SPCX-short, and BTC-route lifecycles; retained as the higher-value no-change action.
expected_upside: Avoids repeated multiple testing on a closed family and preserves research capacity for exact active-route evidence or a genuinely distinct mechanism.
main_risks_and_failure_modes: A later market regime may support range reclaims even though all observed long partitions lost.
The legacy replay used aggregated one-minute bars and a fixed 13-bps round-trip cost rather than the newest exact L2 venue-path contract.
Rejecting the family screen could miss a truly distinct order-flow-conditioned reclaim that is not represented by range_reclaim_v1.
validation_completed: Causal signal identity was compared at the mechanism level rather than by name alone.
Development, validation, and pseudo-holdout economics were inspected separately for both directions and both exit variants.
The no-action decision introduces no execution, risk, sizing, leverage, route, asset, or configuration change.
validation_still_required: No additional validation is required to reject an immediate 120-bar retune of the same family.

Reopening requires a preregistered materially different causal mechanism or explicit evidence of a changed regime before parameters are chosen, then exact SOL L2/trade/funding replay with realistic venue costs and untouched OOS.
failure_or_rollback_triggers: The screening failure conditions were met. No live rollback is required because no change was made.
confidence_level: High confidence that the immediate 120-bar failed-range reclaim retune should not consume another trial; medium confidence in rejecting the broader family indefinitely because future regimes or materially different order-flow conditioning could update the result.
claim_falsifiers: A preregistered mechanism that uses new causal information rather than another range-lookback or threshold choice would make this exact-family equivalence assessment inapplicable.
A predeclared independent regime window with exact venue-path execution that is positive after stress and largest-winner removal could reopen the family.
This decision does not claim that every possible SOL mean-reversion strategy is unprofitable.
single_highest_value_next_investigation: Continue exact both-side HYPE lifecycle collection while the fixed MU transport-parity window reaches its immutable cutoff; neither task changes live authority.
